summary: AI-generated videos often depict people within detailed scenes while leaving their small facial regions poorly resolved. Visual super-resolution can sharpen these regions without resolving whether the recovered lips and teeth agree with the spoken audio.
takeaways: We present an audio-guided facial video restoration framework that addresses this ambiguity within a reference-guided video flow model.
Appearance and synchronization supervision allow the model to recover facial detail and support visual dubbing when the audio is replaced.
On talking-head restoration benchmarks, our method achieves the best paired perceptual similarity and synchronization scores among the compared restoration methods.
